items.title: Conrad Drills 55-Yard Game Winning Field Goal To Lift ECU Past South Florida, 20-17
items.summary: GREENVILLE, N.C. – It's been more than four years since Andrew Conrad enjoyed being on a football field quite this much. But he made Night at the Boneyard on Friday one moment he will never forget.

items.title: ECU-South Florida Meet Friday Night At The Boneyard (7:30 P.M.)
O’Halloran Named To Ray Guy Midseason Watch List
items.summary: AUGUSTA, Ga. – East Carolina punter Tomas O'Halloran is one of 63 FBS punters named to the Midseason Watch List for the 2026 Ray Guy Award, the Augusta Sports Council announced Thursday afternoon. O'Halloran is the first Pirate named to this midseason watch list since Worth Gregory in 2015.

items.title: Dickerson Named Burlsworth Trophy Nominee
items.summary: FAYETTEVILLE, Ark. – East Carolina wide receiver Jason Dickerson is one of 65 nominees for the 2026 Burlsworth Trophy, which recognizes outstanding college football players from across the country who began their careers as walk-ons and have distinguished themselves through their performance, determination and perseverance.

items.title: East Carolina Defeats Temple, 17-9
items.summary: GREENVILLE, N.C. - Dowdy-Ficklen Stadium turned into a haunted house in the fourth quarter of a Halloween clash between East Carolina and Temple on a serene Saturday afternoon. Fortunately for the Pirates, they found more treats than tricks to escape with a 17-9 American Conference victory

items.title: ECU Hosts Temple On Halloween At 3 P.M.
ECU Falls At Memphis In Overtime, 41-34
items.summary: Memphis, Tenn. – East Carolina suffered a devastating dose of déjà vu in consecutive Thursday night American Conference road games.

items.title: ECU Announces Halloween Ticket Special And Game Day Festivities For Temple Matchup
items.summary: GREENVILLE, N.C. — Pirate Nation is in for a treat this Halloween as ECU Athletics announces special ticket pricing and a full lineup of activities surrounding the Pirates' football game against Temple on Saturday, Oct. 31, at Dowdy-Ficklen Stadium.  Kickoff is set for 3 p.m.

items.title: ECU Travels To Memphis For Thursday Night Game On ESPN2
East Carolina, App State To Meet In 2029 Duke’s Mayo Classic In Charlotte
items.summary: GREENVILLE, N.C. – East Carolina and App State will renew their regional rivalry on a prominent stage in the Queen City, meeting in the 2029 Duke's Mayo Classic at Bank of America Stadium in Charlotte, N.C. the Charlotte Sports Foundation and both institutions announced Tuesday.
